skills.description: Analyzes any codebase (Go / JS / TS / Python / Java / Rust / etc.) or a single module/package within a codebase, and generates a thorough, illustrated overview document that helps newcomers ramp up fast. Guiding principle: completeness over brevity — scope size determines doc size.
